reference_sql:
WITH june_sets AS (  -- one row per set of matching June 2024 lines
  SELECT o.store_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.line_discount_eur, p.unit_cost_eur, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01'
  GROUP BY o.store_id, ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur, p.unit_cost_eur
),
per_store AS (  -- one row per store with June 2024 lines
  SELECT store_id,
         SUM(n_lines * (quantity * unit_price_eur - line_discount_eur)) AS revenue_stored,
         SUM(CASE WHEN unit_price_eur > 10 * unit_cost_eur THEN quantity * unit_price_eur / 100 ELSE quantity * unit_price_eur END - line_discount_eur) AS revenue_fixed
  FROM june_sets
  GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT s.store_code, ROUND(ps.revenue_stored, 2) AS revenue_stored, ROUND(ps.revenue_fixed, 2) AS revenue_fixed
FROM per_store ps
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = ps.store_id
WHERE ROUND(ps.revenue_stored, 2) <> ROUND(ps.revenue_fixed, 2)

solver.query:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT o.store_id, ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur,
         ol.unit_price_eur > 10 * p.unit_cost_eur AS cents
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01'
),
stored AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur - line_discount_eur) AS rev FROM base GROUP BY store_id
),
fixed AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(quantity * (CASE WHEN cents THEN unit_price_eur / 100 ELSE unit_price_eur END) - line_discount_eur) AS rev
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur, cents FROM base)
  GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT st.store_code, ROUND(s.rev, 2) AS revenue_stored, ROUND(f.rev, 2) AS revenue_fixed
FROM stored s
JOIN fixed f ON f.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN stores st ON st.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE ROUND(s.rev, 2) <> ROUND(f.rev, 2)
